name: KPAX2_server
//: overrides.qs: express 4 and body-parser 1 pin qs to ~6.15, and 6.15.3 is the
last release of two advisories (array-limit bypass GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx, and
isBuffer DoS GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g) fixed in 6.16.0, which no express 4 release
requires yet. npm's only other remedy is `npm audit fix --force`, which
installs express 5 - a breaking change this app has not been moved to. The
query parser is what every request goes through, so the patched line is
forced for every dependant. Remove this once `npm ls qs` stops reporting
overrides.bson: mongodb 3.7 requires bson ^1.1.4 and resolves 1.1.6 on its own,
so this is only a floor now; it stays so the two critical deserialization
engines: `overrides` is only honoured by npm >= 8.3.0; an older npm ignores the
field silently and installs the vulnerable qs. Node 16.14.0 is the first release
that ships such an npm. .npmrc sets engine-strict so the floor is enforced.
